summary: Photo-mode depth of field on the camera entity (client only; registry total 24 on the client row, none on the server). Written by ecl::photo_mode::DoFSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x1AF6AC0 / step 2 bg3.exe+0x1AF6D30) from its pending ls::Optional<DoFSystem::DoFRequest>, which the photo-mode UI fills through DoFSystem::LEGACY_UpdateDoF(bool,bool,float,float,EntityHandle) (NoesisGameUI.dll+0x71C990 passes the VM properties DepthOfField, SelectedDOFFocusType==0, DOFDistance, DOFStrength and the focused actor). The request and the component have the same 24-byte shape. Never seen alive.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1AF6D30: component stride 0x18 (`base + idx*0x18`); writes byte +0 = request.bool0 && GraphicSettings+0x50 (engine DoF option on); the UI passes VM property 'DepthOfField' here (NoesisGameUI.dll+0x71C990 -> LEGACY_UpdateDoF param 1, +0xBF0 whose symbol 'DepthOfField' is registered at +0xBF4 in NoesisGameUI.dll+0x715A00).

fields.name: AutoFocus
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1AF6D30 compares and copies byte +1. The UI passes `SelectedDOFFocusType == 0` (gui::EDOFFocusType; VM +0xBD8, symbol at +0xBDC) - true for focus type 0; the name follows the FixedString 'DOFAutoFocus' of the render settings, not proven to be type 0's name.

fields.name: Distance
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1AF6D30 compares (epsilon 1.1920929e-07) and copies float +4. The UI passes VM property 'DOFDistance' (VM +0xB48, symbol at +0xB4C) as param 3, which LEGACY_UpdateDoF stores at request+4; request default 5.0 (0x40a00000), macOS default constructor also stores 5.0 at +4.

fields.name: Strength
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1AF6D30 compares and copies float +8. The UI passes VM property 'DOFStrength' (VM +0xB30, symbol at +0xB34) as param 4 -> request+8; request default 2.5 (0x40200000) in EoCClient.dll LEGACY_UpdateDoF; macOS default constructor leaves 0.

fields.name: field_C
fields.evidence: Neither compared nor copied by bg3.exe+0x1AF6D30; LEGACY_UpdateDoF stores a separate 4-byte 0 at request+0xC, macOS default constructor zeroes it (stp xzr,xzr [x23]). Unused member or padding before the 8-byte handle.

fields.name: FocusTarget
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1AF6D30 compares and copies the qword +0x10; request default 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle), macOS default constructor stores -0x40000000000000 at +0x10. The UI passes an entity taken from the VM (the focused actor, cf. VM property 'DepthFocusedActor').

open_questions: Offsets and widths are established on Windows (bg3.exe+0x1AF6D30 and its Toolkit twin EoCClient.dll+0x592640 ecl::photo_mode::DoFSystem::UpdateDoF); the names come from the photo-mode UI properties, not from member names.
Meaning of the bool at +1 (focus type 0 = auto focus?) and of the 4 bytes at +0xC.
